restartBehavior.method: Cloudflare WorkflowInstance.restart() in local Miniflare/Workers Vitest
restartBehavior.limitation: This does not simulate a Cloudflare production deployment or process-level worker/controller loss; reconciliation of an in-flight/indeterminate remote task remains pending.

runtimeCompatibilityFinding.issue: Cloudflare Workerd rejects Fetch redirect mode error before request dispatch
runtimeCompatibilityFinding.fix: Use redirect manual and reject non-2xx responses; redirects are not followed.

localWorkflowRestart.assertion: Restarted completed instance remained terminal in D1 and did not repeat Agent Card discovery or message/send.
localWorkflowRestart.note: Workerd emits an engine-abort diagnostic when the test explicitly invokes restart; Vitest assertions and instance completion pass.

ambiguousRemoteSendRecovery.scenario: Controlled agent records the message/send once and then returns HTTP 503.
ambiguousRemoteSendRecovery.limitation: Does not resolve a real provider task identifier after a lost response; provider-side lookup and true Workerd process loss remain unaccepted.
